Title: Electrochemical ammonia synthesis via nitrate reduction on Fe single atom catalyst
System: Fe single atoms on porous N-doped carbon
KeyFindings: Fe SAC favours nitrate-to-ammonia chemistry; DFT identifies NO* to HNO* and HNO* to N* as potential-limiting steps; isolated sites suppress N-N coupling.

Title: Active hydrogen boosts electrochemical nitrate reduction to ammonia
KeyFindings: Active hydrogen supply and consumption can control nitrate-reduction rate and selectivity; DFT is combined with spectroscopy and isotope evidence.

Title: Single Atom Catalyst for Nitrate-to-Ammonia Electrochemistry
System: Transition-metal SACs on graphene-like carbon and related supports
KeyFindings: Review of nitrate adsorption, metal identity, coordinating atoms, potential-dependent stability, and single/dual-atom effects; identifies stability, adsorption, activity, and selectivity as coupled screening criteria.

Title: Electrocatalytic nitrate reduction to ammonia: bimetallic-site engineering for enhanced activity and selectivity
KeyFindings: Recent example of d-band tuning and intermediate adsorption optimisation in nitrate-to-ammonia catalysis.

Title: Theoretical Exploration of Electrochemical Nitrate Reduction Reaction Activities on Transition-Metal-Doped h-BP
Journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
KeyFindings: Theoretical screening of doped 2D materials for nitrate reduction; reports limiting-potential analysis.

Title: Theoretical Insights into Electrocatalytic Reduction of Nitrates to Ammonia on gC2N Monolayer-Supported Single Nonmetal Atoms
Journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A
KeyFindings: Examines nitrate-to-ammonia pathways on a 2D carbon-nitrogen support and illustrates the expanding design space beyond transition-metal SACs.

Title: A grand canonical study of the potential dependence of nitrate adsorption and dissociation across metals and dilute alloys
SolventModel: Nitrate adsorption and dissociation can depend on applied potential; grand-canonical approaches can differ materially from canonical DFT plus CHE approximations.

Title: Oxygen reduction reaction on single-atom catalysts from density functional theory calculations combined with an implicit solvation model
Journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
SolventModel: Methodological precedent for combining SAC calculations with implicit solvent models; relevant to solvent-model benchmarking even though the reaction is ORR.

Title: New Insights into the Electrochemical Nitrate Reduction
Journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
SolventModel: Reports that CHE-based energetics can overestimate free-energy changes for electrochemical nitrate-reduction steps, motivating explicit validation of electrochemical approximations.

Title: Theoretical insights into superior nitrate reduction to ammonia performance of copper catalysts
SolventModel: Shows the importance of solvation-aware DFT analysis for nitrate-to-ammonia energetics on Cu-based catalysts.
